bio.text: Dione Sims, granddaughter of Fort Worth activist Opal Lee, entered the race for Congress in Texas's 25th District, according to FOX 4 in January 2026, which reported she was in the Democratic primary.
FOX 4 reports that she attended Southwest High School in Fort Worth, earned a business degree at Texas Wesleyan University, and started a nonprofit called Unity Unlimited in 2000.

sources.title: Opal Lee's granddaughter, Dione Sims, enters race for Congress
